topic: What orbital configurations justify prioritizing V-band (57-66 GHz) over optical systems for inter-satellite communication?
consensus_response: V-band is preferred in dynamic LEO constellations due to its robustness against interference, easier alignment, and lower power consumption. Beamforming enhances antenna gain and reduces interference, while adaptive modulation mitigates Doppler shifts and atmospheric effects, ensuring reliable links.
reference_context: SatCom systems utilize various frequency bands, including Ku, Ka, and V-band, for inter-satellite communication, with each band having unique advantages and challenges.
